text: dsh-easy-appearance 为 DSH Web 客户端的原生设置页增加外观控制，接入主题与布局服务。用户可分别调整浅色和深色配色、强调色、文字对比度、壁纸透明度与遮罩，选择字体，导入 VS Code 主题颜色，并编辑自定义 CSS。配置写入插件 profile 并在页面启动时恢复。适用于想定制并保存 DSH 网页外观的用户；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web 客户端，不需要 API key。

dsh-easy-appearance adds appearance controls to DSH Web settings. Users can edit light and dark colors, accents, wallpaper opacity, fonts, import VS Code theme colors, and add custom CSS. Settings persist in the plugin profile. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 Web; no API key.
我想给 DSH 网页版换一套自己的浅色和深色配色。
能不能把自己的图片设成 DSH 的背景壁纸？
让 DSH 的按钮、链接和对话标签统一使用我选的强调色。
我有 VS Code 主题文件，想把其中的颜色带到 DSH 界面里。
希望调整网页和代码字体，还能覆盖自己的 CSS 样式。
DSH 重启后主题总是恢复默认，想保存自己的外观设置。
I want separate custom light and dark color palettes in the DSH web interface.
I want to change the interface and code fonts and add my own CSS styles.
How can I make my appearance settings persist after restarting DSH?
dsh-easy-appearance 的功能「独立浅色与深色配色」：分别保存两套强调色、背景、前景、次要文字和侧栏颜色，供对应主题方案使用。用户在外观设置中编辑目标方案，修改后立即应用。
dsh-easy-appearance 的功能「壁纸与透明度」：通过图片 URL、本地文件或内置渐变设置背景，并独立调整表面透明度和遮罩。选择文件后由浏览器读取为 data URL，再应用到页面背景。
dsh-easy-appearance 的功能「VS Code 主题导入」：解析主题 JSON 的 type 和 colors，将匹配颜色映射到强调色、背景、文字和侧栏。用户选择文件后即可应用。
dsh-easy-appearance 的功能「字体和自定义 CSS」：设置 UI 字体与代码字体，也可编辑 CSS 文本或加载 .css 文件；样式实时插入页面并随外观配置保存。
dsh-easy-appearance 的功能「外观配置持久化」：设置变更时将完整配置序列化并写入插件自己的 DSH profile 配置，保存后检查 Host 回读值；浏览器启动时恢复已保存设置。
dsh-easy-appearance：远程非 loopback 浏览器无法写入 Host 设置，配置仅保留在当前页面。（packages/client/ui-appearance/src/client/index.ts:248-263）

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · dsh-easy-appearance：DeepSeek Harness WebUI 的持久化外观插件 [English](README.en.md) · [安装](#安装到官方-dsh-011-rc2) · [配置说明](#配置说明) · [故障排查](#故障排查) [](LICENSE) [](#已验证快照) [](https://github.com/Zhen-WushuiLingchun/dsh-easy-appearance/releases) 社区维护的 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 外观扩展。它把浅色/深色配色、背景图、透明度、字体、VS Code 主题映射和自定义 CSS 集成进 DSH 原生“设置 → 外观”页面，并把完整配置持久化在插件自己那条约 profile entry 的 `Config` 里（DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的配置表单是唯一写入方）。 > [!IMPORTANT] > `0.2.0` 已迁移为官方 DSH Profile Bundle。安装时不会修改、复制或重新编译官方 DSH 源码。本项目不是 DeepSeek 官方发行物。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 功能一览：| 能力 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 | 继续使用 DSH `ui-theme` 的模式选择，并分别维护浅色与深色配色 |
| 统一强调色 | 同时映射品牌色、业务状态色和信息按钮 token，使对话标签、文件夹、链接、焦点、光标与发送按钮保持一致 |
| 背景图 | 支持 HTTP(S) URL、本地图片上传和四个内置渐变预设 |
| 透明度与遮罩 | 表面透明度控制内容层可见度；独立遮罩保证文字可读 |
| 字体 | 可设置 UI 字体和代码字体，并提供常用预设 |
| VS Code 主题导入 | 从主题 JSON 的 `colors` 字段映射五类核心颜色 |
| 自定义 CSS | 文本或 `.css` 文件实时注入，并随配置持久化 |
| 布局快捷操作 | 折叠/展开侧边栏，打开/关闭详情栏 |
| Host 持久化 | 刷新、卸载/重载插件或重启 DSH 后恢复；写入后会从 Host user layer 精确回读确认 |
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 配置页面：设置页直接嵌入 DSH 原有设置面板，不建立第二套配置程序。浅色和深色各自保存一套强调色、文字、背景与侧边栏颜色；切换方案只编辑目标方案，不会覆盖另一套颜色。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 一处配色，覆盖主要交互状态：早期版本只覆盖 `brand-primary`，因此发送按钮、文件夹、链接和当前对话标签仍可能保留 WebUI 默认蓝色。正式版把同一个强调色投射到这些语义 token：

```text
--dsw-alias-brand-primary
--dsw-alias-brand-primary-new-colorprimary-new-color
--dsw-alias-state-business-primary
--dsw-alias-state-business-tertiary

禁用按钮仍保留组件自身的降透明度规则；只有可交互/激活状态使用配置的强调色。

git clone https://github.com/Zhen-WushuiLingchun/dsh-easy-appearance.git
cd dsh-easy-appearance

./scripts/verify-rc2-compat.ps1

脚本验证 DSH 版本，然后调用官方 Profile Bundle 安装命令：

dsh plugin --profile web add .

也可以安装打包后的 `.tgz`；仓库发布 `0.3.1` 后还可以直接使用 GitHub 源：

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 自动安装：完全退出并重新启动 `dsh web` 或 DSH Desktop，设置中应出现“外观”。安装过程只修改所选 DSH home 的 `profiles/web` 依赖与 bundle 列表，不修改官方程序目录。自定义 profile 可使用 `./scripts/install-into-dsh.ps1 -Profile my-web`。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 主题与配色：- **主题模式**：浅色、深色或跟随系统；模式选择仍由 DSH `ui-theme` 管理。
- **配色目标**：可以先选“配色 · 浅色/深色”，再编辑对应方案。
- **强调色**：对话标签、文件夹、链接、发送按钮、选中状态和焦点状态。
- **前景/次要文字**：主要正文与辅助信息。
- **背景/侧边栏**：基础 WebUI 表面；启用壁纸时基础背景 token 会透明化。
- **对比度**：对表面明暗做统一调整。
- **表面透明度**：越低越能看到壁纸；选择图片时自动调到 50%，100% 时壁纸被不透明表面遮住。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 背景图：- 在“图片 URL”中填写 `https://...` 或 `data:image/...`；
- 通过“本地上传”选择图片，浏览器会使用 `FileReader` 转为 data URL；
- 较大的内嵌图片仍完整持久化，但 URL 输入框只显示估算大小，避免 Electron 把数 MB Base64 绑定到文本控件时出现绘制留白；
- 使用“暮色紫、深海蓝、翡翠绿、暖橙”内置预设；
- 调整遮罩透明度，在壁纸可见度和文字对比度之间取平衡。

壁纸只绘制在一个 `body` 画布上。启用后，共享基础背景 token 变为透明，避免多个嵌套容器重复叠加 50% 透明度而把图片盖住。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · VS Code 主题：选择 VS Code 主题 JSON 后，插件读取顶层 `type` 与 `colors`，并把可用字段映射到强调色、背景、前景、次要文字和侧边栏。`tokenColors`、全部边框和复杂状态色暂不映射。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 字体与自定义 CSS：- UI 字体：支持任意 CSS `font-family`，并提供 Inter、微软雅黑与默认值；
- 代码字体：提供 JetBrains Mono、Fira Code、SF Mono 与默认值；
- 自定义 CSS：支持直接编辑或载入 `.css` 文件，实时写入插件自己的 `<style>`；
- 覆盖主题 token 时，通常需要 `body` 选择器与 `!important`，设置页内置模板可作为起点。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 持久化原理：`ui-appearance` 就是插件自己那条约 profile entry，它的 cordis `Config` 只有**一个 `volatile()` 字符串字段 `config`**：浏览器把完整 `AppearanceConfig` 序列化进去，0.2.0-rc.2 的配置表单（`ctx.configForms.get('ui-appearance')`）是唯一写入方，每次保存后回读并比对完整字符串。写入落在 profile 的补丁层：

```text
$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
```

文件结构类似：

```yaml
- id: ui-appearance
  config:
    config: '{"colors":{"light":{},"dark":{}},"wallpaper":{"url":"data:image/..."}}'
```

实际 JSON 同时包含：

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 持久化原理：```text
colors.light / colors.dark
contrast
surfaceOpacity
wallpaper.url / wallpaper.scrim

因此颜色、透明度、字体、自定义 CSS 和上传后的背景图都会在刷新及 DSH 重启后恢复。上传图片的 data URL 也在同一个持久值内，所以大图会显著增大 `cordis.patch.yml`；本版本尚未建立单独的图片资产库。

远程且非 loopback 的浏览器不会获得高权限 settings API，此时插件只能保持当前页面内存状态。这是安全边界，不是持久化故障。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · 设置中没有“外观”：运行 `dsh plugin --profile web list` 和 `dsh plugin --profile web why @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance`。确认依赖存在后完全退出并重启 `dsh web` 或 Desktop；无需修改官方 DSH 源码或手工重建 WebUI。

Desktop 使用的 profile 名是 `desktop`，请对应执行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop list`。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Desktop 启动即报“应用无法启动”（entry did not activate）：`0.2.0` 在 Electron 托管的 `desktop` profile 上会让浏览器入口停在 `pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)`；Desktop 的启动审计把“有待激活条目”视为致命错误，于是弹出“应用无法启动或已意外停止”。`0.2.1` 只把硬依赖改成延迟注入，因此不再崩溃、但设置页仍然不出现；真正修好的是 `0.3.0`——它改用 0.2.0-rc.2 的配置表单 API。**升级到 `0.3.0`** 即可：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\deepseek-ai-dsh-client-ui-appearance-0.3.1.tgz
```

若应用已卡在该对话框，先点“禁用第三方插件、备份 profile patch 并重启”恢复启动，再执行上面的重装命令。

- 本地上传图片以内联 data URL 保存，可能包含私人图片且体积很大；

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · dsh-easy-appearance：A community-maintained DeepSeek Harness WebUI extension. It adds light/dark palettes, wallpaper, opacity, fonts, selected VS Code theme mapping, and custom CSS to DSH's native Settings → Appearance page, and persists the complete configuration in the plugin's own profile entry `Config` (the DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` configuration form is the only writer).

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Features：| Capability | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Light / dark / system mode | Keeps DSH `ui-theme` mode selection and stores separate light and dark palettes |
| Unified accent | Projects one accent into brand, business-state, and info-button tokens for tabs, folders, links, focus, carets, and send controls |
| Wallpaper | Accepts HTTP(S) URLs, local image uploads, and four built-in gradient presets |
| Opacity and scrim | Controls application-surface visibility independently from the wallpaper readability scrim |
| Fonts | Supports UI and code font stacks with common presets |
| VS Code theme import | Maps five core colors from a theme JSON `colors` object |
| Custom CSS | Loads text or `.css` files live and persists the result |
| Layout actions | Collapses/expands the sidebar and opens/closes the details pane |
| Host persistence | Restores after refresh, plugin reload, or DSH restart and verifies each write against the Host user layer |

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Appearance settings：The section is embedded in DSH's existing settings UI instead of creating a second configuration application. Light and dark schemes keep independent accent, text, background, and sidebar values.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · One accent across major interaction states：The early prototype only changed `brand-primary`, so the send button, folders, links, and current chat tab could keep the stock blue. The formal package projects the configured accent into:

```text
--dsw-alias-brand-primary
--dsw-alias-brand-primary-new-colorprimary-new-color
--dsw-alias-state-business-primary
--dsw-alias-state-business-tertiary

Disabled controls still use each component's normal reduced-opacity rule.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Automated install：Fully exit and restart `dsh web` or DSH Desktop. Appearance should then be present in Settings. Installation only updates the selected DSH home's `profiles/web` dependencies and bundle list; it does not alter the official program directory. A custom profile can be selected with `./scripts/install-into-dsh.ps1 -Profile my-web`.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Theme and colors：- **Theme mode:** light, dark, or system; DSH `ui-theme` remains the owner.
- **Palette target:** select the light or dark palette before editing it.
- **Accent:** active chat tab, folder, link, send, selection, and focus states.
- **Foreground / secondary:** primary content and supporting information.
- **Background / sidebar:** base WebUI surfaces; the base token becomes transparent while wallpaper is active.
- **Contrast:** applies a shared lightness adjustment to surfaces.
- **Surface opacity:** lower values reveal more wallpaper. Selecting an image sets it to 50%; 100% hides wallpaper behind opaque surfaces.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Wallpaper：Enter an `https://...` or `data:image/...` URL, upload a local image through `FileReader`, or choose the Twilight Violet, Deep Ocean, Jade, or Ember built-in gradient. Large embedded images remain fully persisted, but the URL field shows an estimated size instead of binding several megabytes of Base64 to a text control; this avoids blank painting in Electron while preserving the wallpaper. Adjust the separate scrim to retain foreground readability.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Wallpaper：Wallpaper is painted once on the `body` canvas. While enabled, the shared base-background token becomes transparent so nested WebUI surfaces do not compound 50% opacity and obscure the image.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · VS Code themes：The importer reads the top-level `type` and `colors` objects, then maps available values to accent, background, foreground, secondary text, and sidebar. `tokenColors`, the complete border system, and complex state colors are not mapped in this release.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Fonts and custom CSS：- UI fonts accept any CSS `font-family`; presets include Inter, Microsoft YaHei, and default.
- Code presets include JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, SF Mono, and default.
- Custom CSS can be edited directly or loaded from a `.css` file and is injected through a package-owned `<style>` element.
- Theme-token overrides generally need a `body` selector and `!important`; the built-in template provides examples.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Persistence model：`ui-appearance` is the plugin's own profile entry, and its cordis `Config` holds exactly **one `volatile()` string field, `config`**: the browser serializes the complete `AppearanceConfig` into it, and the `0.2.0-rc.2` configuration forms (`ctx.configForms.get('ui-appearance')`) are the only writer. Each save is read back and compared as a whole string. The value lands in the profile's patch layer:

```text
$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
```

The document resembles:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Persistence model：```yaml
- id: ui-appearance
  config:
    config: '{"colors":{"light":{},"dark":{}},"wallpaper":{"url":"data:image/..."}}'
```

The real JSON also includes `contrast`, `surfaceOpacity`, both font stacks, the wallpaper scrim, and custom CSS. Uploaded-image data URLs are part of the same durable value, so large images significantly increase the size of `cordis.patch.yml`; this release does not maintain a separate image asset store.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Persistence model：A remote, non-loopback browser is not given the privileged settings API and therefore remains memory-only. That is an intentional security boundary.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Appearance is missing from Settings：Run `dsh plugin --profile web list` and `dsh plugin --profile web why @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance`. If the dependency exists, fully restart `dsh web` or Desktop. No official DSH source edits or manual Web bundle changes are required.

Desktop runs the `desktop` profile, so use `dsh plugin --profile desktop list` there.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Desktop aborts startup ("entry did not activate")：On the Electron-managed `desktop` profile, `0.2.0` left the browser entry stuck in `pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)`; the Desktop boot audit treats a pending entry as fatal and reports "the application could not start". `0.2.1` only turned the hard dependency into deferred injection, so the abort stopped but Appearance still never appeared; `0.3.0` is the real fix, because it uses the `0.2.0-rc.2` configuration-form API. **Upgrade to `0.3.0`**:
section: Desktop aborts startup ("entry did not activate")

dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance

```

2. Temporarily reduce the wallpaper scrim.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Upgrading and removal：Back up `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, then update by running `dsh plugin --profile web add <new package or GitHub source>` again.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Upgrading and removal：To disable, run `dsh plugin --profile web remove @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance`. This removes the package and bundle from the profile but does not intentionally delete the entry's `config` field, so reinstalling can recover the theme. Deleting that override from `cordis.patch.yml` should remain a separate, explicit user decision after a backup.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-appearance README · Privacy and security boundaries：- Never commit `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` to a public repository.
- Uploaded images become inline data URLs and may be private or large.
- Common DSH home, credential, session, and local-settings paths are ignored here.
- Custom CSS can alter the current WebUI; only import CSS you trust.
- Documentation images have been privacy-sanitized and do not contain the original workspace or conversation data.
